[{"id": 551249352, "iid": 290, "title": "feat(blocks): quick starts carry a real, measured application", "description": "## Why

The three Quick Starts (CNN Inference Pipeline, FFT Signal Processing, Sensor Fusion Control) and the six `/auth/templates` demos carried no code, no data and no measurement: filler durations passed to the scheduler as cycles, chains sold as multi-core parallelism, a SoC body the mapper refuses, and a simulation verdict judged on a `VexRiscv` banner substring. Nothing of the bit-exact harness was reachable from the API.

## What

- `yoob.blocks.reference_application`: a `ReferenceApplication` carries task bodies, input and expected fixtures, a licence with its derivation, and cycle counts that cannot exist without the command that measured them. The SoC body raises at declaration on the combination the mapper rejects.
- One application ships: Sobel edges and motion fusion on two consecutive 64x64 frames of OpenCV `vtest.avi` (Apache-2.0, upstream digest and derivation in `docs/licences/third-party-data.md`). WCETs measured with the RISC-V profiler; `run_golden` reproduces both expected outputs with 0 mismatches / 4096.
- `GET /api/v1/reference-applications` and `/{id}` serve the catalogue with C bodies, provenance and `proof_status`; `POST /{id}/graphs` creates the project graph. `/auth/templates` serves the same catalogue; the six hard-coded templates and the graph editor's example templates are deleted.
- The landing demo runs a reference graph through the golden sandbox on its fixtures and reports mismatches per output (`reference_check`), bounded by the per-task timeout; user bodies never enter that path.
- The quick-start run stops after codegen and shows cosim and synthesis as `not executed`.
- One simulation verdict, `yoob.simulation.console_verdict.judge_simulation_output`: whole-line `YOOB_BOOT` / `YOOB_DONE` when firmware is loaded, `BIOS CRC passed` otherwise. Used by the API task, `SimulationResult` and `SimulationRunner`; the banner-substring checks are gone. Standard-mode firmware now prints both markers.
- `FunctionalSimulator`: a run where every task raised is `failed`, not `executed`; a C body is reported as not executable by the functional simulator, not as "no code".

## Proof

- `tests/blocks/test_reference_applications.py` 33 passed in the three toolchain environments (host gcc 13.2, python-ci gcc 12.2, synthesis image gcc 10.2): the WCET re-measurement equals the declared row of the toolchain found, nowhere skipped. Headline cycles are the synthesis-image row, the toolchain the platform runs; the other two rows are kept with their provenance.
- `api/tests/test_try_now.py::test_anonymous_run_of_every_bundled_template_executes[sobel-motion-fusion]`: 200, both outputs 0 / 4096; 422 on the commit before the golden route.
- `api/tests/test_simulation_verdict.py`: 12 cases, including the Celery task driven on its real path with and without firmware.
- Independently re-verified four times (every condition re-run, diff read for weakened tests): tests/blocks + tests/simulation + tests/core_misc 399 passed, API touched files 116 passed, frontend type-check/lint and 929 unit tests, ruff and lint-conventions 0, licence headers unchanged (1918).

## Out of scope

The owner's two repositories encode the same development method twice: repoach as a governed tool, Yoob as CLAUDE.md, hooks and memory rules. Reconciling them showed what Yoob stated but never enforced, what it enforced at the wrong cost, and what lived only in a gitignored file. The owner decided the seven open questions on 2026-10-18.

## What

- `docs/developer_guide/method.md`: the single reference, 50 numbered rules with "enforced by" and source, the reconciliation table with the incidents each verdict rests on, the applied patch plan.
- Commit gate becomes native: ruff, format and the conventions checks run on the index content in about a second (measured 0.99 s against 520 s for the Docker lane on the same three files); Docker stays at pre-push and behind `YOOB_PRECOMMIT_DOCKER=1`.
- Hook wiring is versioned in `.claude/settings.json` (eleven hooks, identical to the local file; a fresh clone now has every gate); the inert `Bash(git commit*)` matcher is dropped.
- Agent edits to the gates (`.gitlab-ci.yml`, `ci/`, `scripts/hooks/`, `.claude/`, `.gemini/`, `.agents/`) are allowed, logged in the git common dir and answered with the suite that must run; `.env*` writes are refused.
- Conventions gate ratchets: `# noqa` baseline 12 and silent `except` baseline 166 over non-vendored `src/yoob`, red only above the baseline, a notice below it.
- `docs/specs/` with the template and the two specs of the worksites in flight; `/verify`, `/brief` and `/dream` agents encoding the owner's rules; `/dream` explicit, `feedback_*` notes immutable; `commit.md` forbids `wip`.
- `scripts/mr-create.sh`: refuses a branch not reconciled with `origin/develop`, pushes and opens the MR in one motion, arms auto-merge by API; the release MR waits on a green develop pipeline for the exact SHA.
- Delegate engine secrets scrubbed with a never-strip list for session plumbing.

## Proof

- Five new shell suites and one Python test, all auto-collected: `test_shell_suites.py` 43 passed; pre-commit 105, agent-gate-edits 34, hook wiring 4, dream 9, mr-create 26, gemini parity 62, lint-conventions 96, spec frontmatter 11, documentation paths 402.

Issue #5: three `test_accelerator_generation_*` cases failed only in the full local suite. The ticket suspected the module-scoped SQLite engine fixture. Bisection names another culprit.

## Root cause

`api/tests/test_cpu_type_guard_parity.py::test_importing_api_tasks_does_not_load_synthesis_layer` evicts `api.tasks` from `sys.modules`, reimports it and restores only the `sys.modules` entry: the `api` package keeps the fresh copy as its `tasks` attribute, with its own Celery app and task objects. The accelerator test stubs `apply_async` on one copy; the route dispatches through the other, so a real Redis dispatch runs, retries 20 times and answers 503. CI has a Redis service, so it passed there. The refused case 403s before the route body, which is why only two of the three cases failed.

## What

- `_reimport_scope` rebinds every restored module on its parent package and restores Celery's current app.
- An autouse guard in `api/tests/conftest.py` fails the test that leaves an `api.*` or `yoob.*` module split from its parent package, naming the polluter rather than the victim (1.8 ms per test).
- `docs/BACKLOG.md`: B-044 corrected and closed; two new debt rows for what the investigation exposed: 79 test files reassign `api.database.engine` without restoring it while `api/tasks.py` reads `SessionLocal` at run time, and the guard's two blind spots.

## Proof

- Minimal order `pytest tests/test_cpu_type_guard_parity.py tests/test_verified_email_gate.py`: 2 failed on develop (503 `SERVER_002`), 23 passed here.
- CI-equivalent `pytest api/tests`: 1980 passed in 410 s (develop: 2 failed, 980 s because of the Redis retries); two random seeds green.
- Independently re-verified (old parity file against the new guard → 2 errors naming `api.schemas.soc` and `api.tasks`).

## What

- Template durations are served as `duration_declared` with `duration_provenance: "declared"`; the panel shows each task's value with "declared" beside it, or "no duration"; a template task with no duration is refused at instantiation (422 naming the task) instead of defaulting to 10.
- A graph born from a template carries `duration_provenance` through both paths (server-side `/graphs/from-template` and the client-side canvas save) into the schedule, and the scheduling result says "on declared durations"; the field accepts only the literal "declared", so a client cannot relabel placeholders as measured.
- AMP firmware builds render `yoob_peripherals.h` per core from `csr.csv` and include it in the per-core tasks; the `ArchConfig` refusal is lifted; the cosim harness passes `csr_csv` on the AMP path too.

## Proof

- `grep -rn "|| 10" frontend/src` is empty; blocks, API and frontend tests fail on develop and pass here (83 Python tests across the six touched files, 961 frontend unit tests, type-check and lint clean).
- A real 2-core AMP SoC declaring `spi0` builds and co-simulates with both core headers bound to `csr.csv` (fails on the previous tree with the late `ValueError`); the default AMP firmware images are byte-identical to develop.
